rejected_attempts.reason: Checked at full size: the two leather-strap legs do not read as the ghoul's own legs; they look like ordinary belts and buckles the traveller is fastening (GAMBAR §6.1 'atribut tidak terbaca'). Redraw so both long strap legs grow visibly out of the old ghoul's hips, with no feet, buckles or belt hardware, and coil tightly round the traveller's waist while he strains; keep the old-man head, two arms and night river path.

The three figures read as ordinary full-size labourers carrying stones (GAMBAR §6.1 'manusia biasa'); the documented small stature (c01/c10) and the impossible one-night build are not readable. Redraw at dead of night with a clear scale cue beside them (a normal-size stone course, fern or tool reaching their chest), the precision-fitted watercourse visibly stretching far behind them as if raised in hours, torchlight from one source; keep exactly three, opaque work wraps, no magic glow.

Giant stature (c01) is not readable: with no nearby comparison he looks like an ordinary man climbing a hill (GAMBAR §6.1 'manusia biasa, seukuran manusia'). Redraw with a scale cue at his feet or knees (trees, boulders, a small village or people) on the barren Mixteca hills, low camera, dust from his step; keep the plain opaque tunic and no weapons or headdress.
